catalogue.title: What do you need?
catalogue.lede: Every price here is {clinic}'s own. Choose what you need, then choose a time that suits you.
catalogue.emptyBody: {clinic} has not published anything you can book from here. Call them and the front desk will book for you.
catalogue.emptyBodyWithPhone: {clinic} has not published anything you can book from here. Call them on {phone} and the front desk will book for you.
catalogue.unavailableTitle: The list of services did not load
catalogue.unavailableBody: Nothing you have done is wrong and nothing has been booked. Try again in a moment.
catalogue.unavailableGeneric: We could not reach {clinic} just now.

modes.inPersonNote: You travel to the clinic and are seen in person.
modes.videoNote: You and the clinician see each other. Uses the most data.
modes.voiceNote: A call with no picture. Works on a weak connection.
modes.chatNote: You type to each other. Uses the least data.

booking.title: Book {service}
booking.noServiceBody: Pick a service and this page will show you the times {clinic} has free for it.
booking.withdrawnBody: {clinic} has withdrawn this service. Choose something else, or call the clinic if you were expecting it.
booking.clinicianLabel: Who you would like to see
booking.modeLegend: How would you like to be seen?
booking.modeHint: Voice and chat are proper consultations, not a lesser version of video. Choose whichever suits your connection.
booking.slotHint: Times are shown in Uganda time. Another patient may take a time while you are reading this page, so we check again when you confirm.
booking.noSlotsTitle: No free times in this range
booking.noSlotsBody: Try another day, or choose {anyClinician} to see everyone's times.
booking.truncated: Showing the first {count} times. Choose a day or a clinician to see the rest.
booking.paymentLegend: How would you like to pay?
booking.payNowNote: You will get a prompt on your phone. Your time is held for {minutes} minutes while you complete it.
booking.payAtClinicNote: Your booking is confirmed straight away and you pay {clinic} when you arrive.
booking.payAtClinicOnlyTitle: You will pay at the clinic
booking.payAtClinicOnlyBody: {clinic} does not take payment through this portal, so this booking is confirmed straight away and you pay them when you arrive.
booking.priceNote: You are booking {service} with {clinic}. The fee is paid to {clinic}.
booking.slotTakenBody: It went while you were choosing, which happens. Nothing has been booked and you have not been charged. The times below are the ones still free.
booking.refusedTitle: This clinic is not taking bookings from the portal
booking.refusedBody: Call {clinic} and the front desk can book this time for you.
booking.refusedBodyWithPhone: Call {clinic} on {phone} and the front desk can book this time for you.
booking.incompleteBody: Choose a time and how you would like to be seen, then confirm again.
booking.failedTitle: The booking did not go through
booking.failedBody: Nothing has been booked and you have not been charged. Try again in a moment.

appointments.bookedBody: Your reference is {reference}. Say that number if you telephone the clinic.
appointments.cancelledBody: That time has gone back to the clinic. You can book another whenever you are ready.
appointments.clinicianUnknown: The clinic will confirm who you will see
appointments.emptyUpcomingBody: When you book with {clinic}, it will appear here with the time and how you will be seen.
appointments.emptyPastBody: Appointments move here once their time has passed.
appointments.holdTitle: This time is held while you pay
appointments.holdBody: Held until {time}. If {clinic} has not been paid by then, the time goes back to the clinic and you will need to book again.
appointments.holdMinutesLeft: {minutes, plural, =0 {Less than a minute left} one {# minute left} other {# minutes left}}
appointments.holdEnded: This hold has ended. The time has gone back to the clinic.
appointments.showStart: Back to the start of the list
appointments.cancelReasonHint: The clinic reads this. A few words is enough — please do not write anything about your health here.
appointments.cancelFailedBody: Nothing has changed. Call the clinic if you cannot cancel from here.
appointments.unavailableBody: Nothing has changed and nothing has been cancelled. Try again in a moment.
appointments.unavailableGeneric: We could not reach {clinic} just now.
